info.description: The 15- unit course equips students with solid knowledge of planning, organizing and delivering different types of speeches in public. Specific skills include selecting the topic and the main goal, analyzing audience, searching for information, organizing ideas, outlining a speech, beginning and ending a speech, using language and visual aids, speaking to inform and persuade in order to deliver an effective speech.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Remember the steps to prepare different types of speeches
Understand techniques to select the topic and the main goal, to use visual aids and language effectively, to search for information, to organize ideas and to outline a speech
Apply the learnt techniques to plan, organize and deliver different types of speeches
Analyze components of a specific public speech in details
Deliver impressive and effective public speeches
